profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, with the ticker CCC and SEC CIK 0001818201. The website listed for the company is calgoncarbon.com.

The text on that site does not describe CCC Intelligent Solutions. It describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon company addressing air and water purification, and describes FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon that the site says has over 40 years of use in TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. The site says FILTRASORB is made in the United States. No AI products are described in the harvested site text.

The held facts list no products, no MCP servers, and no cases for the company. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with a count of 375.
